rocslope2.StatsDistribution module#

class StatsDistribution(propertyName: str, property_accessor: StatsDistributionPropertyAccessor)#

Bases: object

Statistical distribution settings for a probabilistic input property.

Examples: Code Snippet: Statistical Distributions

getMean() → float#
setMean(mean: float)#

getRelMin() → float#

Sets the relative minimum bound for sampling (distance below the mean, in standard deviations).

getRelMax() → float#
setRelMax(relMax: float)#

Sets the relative maximum bound for sampling (distance above the mean, in standard deviations).
